_guidelines: Kaidon Labs blog content guardrails: (1) Write general AI-adoption and business-education content in Kaidon Labs' voice — professional but approachable, practical, results-driven, minimal jargon. (2) Do NOT fabricate client stories, case studies, testimonials, or named customer examples. (3) Do NOT invent statistics, survey numbers, or research findings presented as fact; if a number is needed, keep it qualitative or clearly framed as illustrative, not cited as real data. (4) Every post should end with a soft call-to-action pointing back to booking a meeting (https://calendly.com/brian-kaidonlabs/30min) or the site's contact section (/#contact) — never pushy, always optional next step. (5) Stay evergreen: avoid time-sensitive claims that will date quickly. (6) Topics are drawn from the pool below and tracked in "used" to avoid repeats; once every topic has been used, the pool may be recycled with fresh angles.
